text: この　おみせ　はじめた　ばかり　なんです！

patterns.name: 〜たばかり
patterns.explanation: ばかり after a past verb says the thing happened only a moment ago. はじめた ばかり = 'only just started'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んです at the end gives the sentence an explaining tone, like 'you see'. はじめた ばかり なんです = 'I've only just started it, you see'.
